items.title: AI Agent 是长期运行的“风险系统”，如果你还只在防 Prompt Injection，说明已经落后一代了
items.raw_excerpt: 为防止大语言模型和 AI Agent 执行嵌入在外部数据中的恶意指令， 所有进入 Agent 上下文的文本在完成校验之前都必须被视为不可信数据 ，其中不仅包括用户输入的提示，还包括来自外部系统的各类信息。AI 安全公司 CyberArk 的首席软件架构师 Niv Rabin 表示。为此，他所在的团队提出了一种基于“指令检测”（Instruction Detection）与“历史感知校验”（History-Aware Validation）的方法，用于同时防御恶意输入数据和上下文历史投毒攻击。

title_i18n.zh: AI Agent 是长期运行的“风险系统”，如果你还只在防 Prompt Injection，说明已经落后一代了
title_i18n.en: AI Agents are long-running "risk systems." If you're still only guarding against Prompt Injection, you're already a generation behind.
title_i18n.es: AI Agent es un "sistema de riesgo" de larga duración; si aún solo te proteges del Prompt Injection, significa que ya estás una generación atrasado.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 为防止大语言模型和 AI Agent 执行嵌入在外部数据中的恶意指令， 所有进入 Agent 上下文的文本在完成校验之前都必须被视为不可信数据 ，其中不仅包括用户输入的提示，还包括来自外部系统的各类信息。AI 安全公司 CyberArk 的首席软件架构师 Niv Rabin 表示。为此，他所在的团队提出了一种基于“指令检测”（Instruction Detection）与“历史感知校验”（History-Aware Validation）的方法，用于同时防御恶意输入数据和上下文历史投毒攻击。
excerpt_i18n.en: To prevent large language models and AI Agents from executing malicious instructions embedded in external data, all text entering the Agent context must be treated as untrusted data until verification is completed. This includes not only user-input prompts but also various types of information from external systems, according to Niv Rabin, Chief Software Architect at AI security company CyberArk. To address this, his team has proposed a method based on "Instruction Detection" and "History-Aware Validation" to defend against both malicious input data and context history poisoning attacks simultaneously.
excerpt_i18n.es: Para evitar que los modelos de lenguaje extenso y los agentes de IA ejecuten instrucciones maliciosas incrustadas en datos externos, todo texto que ingrese al contexto del agente debe considerarse como datos no confiables hasta que se complete la verificación. Esto incluye no solo las indicaciones ingresadas por el usuario, sino también diversos tipos de información proveniente de sistemas externos, señaló Niv Rabin, arquitecto jefe de software de la empresa de seguridad cibernética CyberArk. Para abordar esto, su equipo propuso un enfoque basado en "detección de instrucciones" y "validación consciente del historial".

title_i18n.en: In his first interview since leaving OpenAI after seven years, a veteran executive spoke out: The "entertainment" trend in the large model industry has intensified pressure, and Google should not rush to boast this time—it's essentially still OpenAI's mistake.
title_i18n.es: Tras siete años en OpenAI, un veterano habla por primera vez tras su salida: la "espectacularización" del círculo de modelos grandes ha elevado la presión al máximo, y en esta ocasión, Google no debería apresurarse a alardear, ya que en esencia se trata de un error de OpenAI.

excerpt_i18n.en: In the first month of 2026, when news broke that Jerry Tworek was leaving OpenAI, several employees expressed surprise, commenting on X: "I'm really devastated" and "This is so hard."
excerpt_i18n.es: En el primer mes de 2026, cuando se difundió la noticia de que Jerry Tworek abandonaba OpenAI, varios empleados de la empresa se mostraron sorprendidos y comentaron en X: "Estoy realmente destrozado" y "Esto es muy duro".

items.title: 清华教授翟季冬：Benchmark正在「失效」，智能路由终结大模型选型乱象
items.raw_excerpt: 作者 | 赵之齐 编辑 | 包永刚 北京一月的初雪落下前，我们在清华见到了翟季冬教授。他手持保温杯，说话很利落，即便一边思考一边叙述，言辞间也几乎没有停顿、没有模糊地带。 这位曾带队拿下15次世界超算冠军的清华计算机系长聘教授，此刻正在拆解一个行业怪象： 为什么在大模型参数狂飙、算力价格下探的当下，用户的AI落地负担却越来越重？ 他指出，如今Benchmark（基准测试）上的高分，在比对用户真实需求时不一定管用，有时，同个模型在不同MaaS平台上跑出来的效果可能差异巨大，因为部分服务商为了降低成本，会对模型进行“阉割级”量化。而面对眼花缭乱的MaaS供应商，用户要在性能、价格与稳定性之间做取舍，往往光调研一轮市场报价，就已耗尽精力。 “把选型的主动权完全交给用户，其实是很大的挑战” ， 翟季冬直言。这种“选择悖论”不仅折磨着开发者，更在吞噬企业的利润——对于企业来说， 降本增效的核心可能并非追求最顶尖的模型，而是如何调度能力恰当的模型，让昂贵的大模型处理复杂指令，让轻量的小模型应付日常任务。 洞察到这一痛点后，由翟季冬的几位毕业学生发起的AI Infra厂商——清程极智，开发出智能路由产品AI Ping（AI 评），希望成为算力界的“大众点评”。 他们将分散的性能数据系统性整理，并收集用户的使用习惯，公开不同模型与供应商的测评数据，并给用户推荐合适的、高性价比方案。翟季冬认为，这种产品形态， 有助于撬动算力行业的马太效应——他相信，当数据越集中，模型的选择就越精准；选择越精准，用户需要付出的成本就越低。 翟季冬 与我们交流时，尽管判断明确，翟季冬说话时的语气却始终都是温和的。他走进会议室时，手上拎着提前为我们备好的饮用水；对话结束后，还为北京凛冽的寒潮给我们来访带来的困扰而“致歉”。待人的认真，也换来了学生们的真心相待——在许多博士生习惯将导师称为“老板”的当下，他的博士生

excerpt_i18n.en:
Author | Zhao Zhiqi  Editor | Bao Yonggang  
Before the first snow of January fell in Beijing, we met Professor Zhai Jidong at Tsinghua University. Holding a thermal cup, he spoke briskly, with almost no pauses or ambiguities even while thinking and narrating simultaneously.  
This tenured professor from Tsinghua’s Department of Computer Science, who has led his team to win 15 world supercomputing championships, is now dissecting an industry anomaly:  
Why, amid the soaring parameters of large models and the declining cost of computing power, are users’ burdens for AI implementation becoming increasingly heavy?  
He points out that high scores on benchmarks may not always align with users’ actual needs. Sometimes, the same model can perform vastly differently across various MaaS platforms, as some providers apply “castration-level” quantization to reduce costs. Faced with a dizzying array of MaaS suppliers, users must weigh performance, price, and stability, often exhausting their energy just by surveying market quotes.  
“Leaving the initiative of model selection entirely to users is actually a significant challenge,” Zhai Jidong states frankly. This “paradox of choice” not only torments developers but also erodes corporate profits. For enterprises, the core of cost reduction and efficiency improvement may not lie in pursuing the most cutting-edge models, but in how to deploy appropriately capable models—using expensive large models for complex instructions and lightweight small models for routine tasks.  
Recognizing this pain point, Qingcheng Jizhi, an AI infrastructure startup founded by several of Zhai Jidong’s former students, has developed an intelligent routing system.
excerpt_i18n.es: Autor | Zhao Zhiqi Editor | Bao Yonggang. Antes de la primera nevada de enero en Pekín, nos encontramos con el profesor Zhai Jidong en la Universidad Tsinghua. Sosteniendo un termo, hablaba con fluidez, sin apenas pausas ni ambigüedades, incluso mientras reflexionaba y narraba. Este profesor titular del Departamento de Informática de Tsinghua, que ha liderado al equipo para ganar 15 campeonatos mundiales de supercomputación, estaba desentrañando una peculiaridad del sector: ¿Por qué, en un momento en que los parámetros de los grandes modelos se disparan y los precios de la potencia de cálculo bajan, la carga de implementación de IA para los usuarios es cada vez mayor? Señaló que los altos puntajes en los Benchmark (pruebas de referencia) actuales no siempre son útiles al compararlos con las necesidades reales de los usuarios; a veces, el mismo modelo en diferentes...

items.title: InsAIts V2 – Real-time monitoring for multi-agent AI communication
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN,
I'm Cristian, an indie developer from Italy working on tools to make multi-agent AI safer and more debuggable.
When agents talk to each other (CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, custom setups), they quickly develop shorthand, lose context, invent jargon, and propagate hallucinations — all invisible to us.
InsAIts is a lightweight Python SDK that adds observability in ~3 lines of code.
V2 just shipped with: Anchor-aware detection (set the user's original query as context to reduce false positives)
Forensic root-cause tracing + ASCII chain visualization
Built-in domain dictionaries (finance, healthcare, kubernetes, ML, devops, quantum)
Local (Ollama) decipher mode — translates agent jargon to human-readable (Cloud soon)
Integrations: Slack alerts, Notion/Airtable export, LangGraph/CrewAI wra
